shortDescription: Configures a virtual directory in IIS

options.name: application
options.description: The application under which the virtual directory is created or exists.

options.name: connect_as
options.description: The type of authentication to use for the virtual directory. Either V(pass_through) or V(specific_user). If V(pass_through), IIS uses the identity of the user or application pool identity to access the physical path. If V(specific_user), IIS uses the credentials provided in username and password to access the physical path.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the virtual directory to create.

options.name: password
options.description: The password associated with O(username). Required when O(connect_as=specific_user).

options.name: physical_path
options.description: The physical path to the folder in which the new virtual directory is created. The specified folder must already exist. This must be set when O(state=present) and the virtual directory does not already exist.

options.name: site
options.description: The site name under which the virtual directory should exist.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether to add or remove the specified virtual directory. Removing will delete the virtual directory and all its contents recursively.

options.name: username
options.description: Specifies the username of an account that can access configuration files and content for the virtual directory. Required when O(connect_as=specific_user).
